mods.name: Wooden Cog
mods.description:
Woodencog is a compatibility mod for create and TFC. This mod allow the player to automate almost every aspect of TFC with create.

- every alloy can be made in a basin (with some black magics and bug fixing you can now input 4 fluids into basins)
- There is now a small crucible (item like a bucket) that can hold 100mb of a fluid, so you can use it as a fluid filter on a basin or smart pipe
- some tfc items now give information on engineers goggles
- Temperature of item can be handled with fans (heating and cooling)
- Charcoal forge can be accessed by a mechanical arm
- Machine can damage over time and need to be repaired with an hammer
